tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on it: the reading column, the lock screen, the inside of a dashed quick-add field. Also the text color on inverted surfaces (primary button, toast).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Anything lifted off the page: an expanded entry, the composer slide-over, the command palette, the toast-free bulk bar, inputs, kbd caps. One notch brighter than bg in light, one notch lighter than bg in dark.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: The sidebar ground and the 'your data' band on the landing page. Recedes from bg in light, deepens below it in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: entry row separators, input and button borders, section rules, the sidebar edge, kbd caps. This system separates with borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and side (4.5:1+ in both themes). Also the fill of inverted surfaces: primary buttons, the toast, the switch track when on, the row checkmark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text at 12.5px and up: entry snippets, subtitles, hints, ghost buttons, the focus-ring color. 4.75:1 on bg in light, 6.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks only: uppercase micro-labels, word counts, placeholders, the resting star and row picker. Deliberately below 4.5:1 on bg (2.3:1 light, 3.3:1 dark) — never use it for a sentence a reader must read. Use muted instead when the text carries meaning.

tokens.name: faint-text
tokens.usage: The readable cousin of faint, used on the landing page for fine print (waitlist note, shipped-on line, keyboard legend) at 13-14px. 3.4:1 on bg — reserve for supporting copy, not body text.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Hover tint on a row or nav item, and the ground of the AI breakdown card. Ink at low alpha so it tints whatever is behind it.

tokens.name: washon
tokens.usage: Selected state of the same surfaces: the active nav item, the highlighted palette row, the active palette tab.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the composer slide-over, with a 3px backdrop blur. One value in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim-light
tokens.usage: Behind the command palette and the quick-dump modal, which sit closer to the page than the composer.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: The one alarm color: a thin-category count in the sidebar, a stale-backup notice, destructive button hover, form errors. 5.6:1 on bg in light. Never decorative.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: A pinned entry's star, hover and on. The only gold in the system.

tokens.name: tagbg
tokens.usage: The luggage-tag fill on used-in tags, and the text selection highlight.

tokens.name: tagink
tokens.usage: Text on tagbg. 4.6:1 on its own tag fill in light, 7.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: cat-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a filled category chip in the light theme, where the pastel category color is the ground. In dark the chip inverts instead: the category hue becomes the text on a 16% tint of itself.

tokens.name: c0
tokens.usage: Category 0, Community/Perspective. Apricot. Used as a 9px dot, a chip fill and the highlighter stroke behind that category's heading. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: c1
tokens.usage: Category 1, Leadership. Faded rose. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: c2
tokens.usage: Category 2, Why School. Sage. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: c3
tokens.usage: Category 3, Why Major. Dusty blue. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: c4
tokens.usage: Category 4, Creative. Lilac. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: c5
tokens.usage: Category 5, Problem-solver. Straw. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: c6
tokens.usage: Category 6, My favorite topic. Seafoam. Identical in both themes.

shadow.note: Two shadows only. Borders do the separating; shadow is reserved for things that genuinely float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Overlays: the command palette, the composer slide-over, the quick-dump box, the bulk bar, tag suggestions, the landing-page product mock.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: The gentle version, for an entry that expanded in place and the builder's note card. Also the hover lift on a primary button.

families.serif: ui-serif, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing-page headline only. Fluid in use: clamp(34px, 6vw, 56px).
styles.sample: Every good detail you will ever need.

styles.name: view-heading
styles.usage: The category heading at the top of a view, always wrapped in the highlighter stroke. text-wrap: balance.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: An entry's title once it is expanded. Collapsed, the same title is sans at 15px — the switch to serif is what signals reading mode.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Entry body text, the only long-form surface in the app. white-space: pre-wrap so the writer's own line breaks survive.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: A school's prompt quoted back to the writer, and the AI's 'why this fits' line. Italic serif marks text the app is echoing, not text it is asserting.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The interface default set on body. Entry titles in a list, composer body text.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: A collapsed entry's title in the list.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, toasts, palette inputs.

styles.name: snippet
styles.usage: Two-line entry preview, view subtitles, empty states, search fields. Set in muted.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, hints under a control. muted, or faint where it is only a marker.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Luggage-tag text and category names under an entry row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels: sidebar group headings, composer field labels, palette section headings. Always uppercased in CSS, never typed in caps. Set in faint.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark in the sidebar, uppercase in muted. The landing page instead sets the brand in serif at 19px with the highlighter stroke on the first letter.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Text inside a keycap. 12px on the landing page, where keycaps appear in running copy.

spacing.note: There is no arithmetic scale here — the app was built by eye and the values below are the ones that actually recur. Treat them as the vocabulary, not as a grid to snap to. Odd values (7, 9, 13) are real and intentional; do not round them.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between category dots in a cluster; the tightest rhythm in the system.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip and tag gaps, nav item icon-to-label, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item horizontal padding, tag internal padding, the standard small gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, the gap between an entry's text and its right-hand controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Entry row vertical padding, sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Expanded entry padding, section rules above an action row, the composer's inner rhythm.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Composer top padding, the note card's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Reading column side padding on desktop; 18px at phone width.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Landing-page section padding-block; 56px at phone width.

tokens.name: measure-read
tokens.usage: The reading column's max width — the single most important measurement in the app. Long-form prose never runs wider.

tokens.name: measure-sub
tokens.usage: Max width for a view subtitle; 44ch for empty states, 60ch for the guide card. Set in ch so the measure holds at any font size.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width. Below 760px the sidebar becomes a horizontally scrolling top bar of pill nav items.

radius.note: Radius encodes scale: the bigger the surface, the rounder the corner. Pills are reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps and the smallest hit targets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tag inputs, suggestion rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, nav items, search fields, palette rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The primary 'New entry' button, waitlist fields, the quick-add textarea — controls that invite a first click.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: An entry expanded in place.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Overlay containers: the command palette, the quick-dump box, the product mock.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The bulk bar, the toast, the switch track, category chips, and nav items in the mobile top bar.
